2020-09-08 22:32:09 ERROR (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.websocket_api.http.connection.140574209900608] Error handling message: Unknown error

  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/kodi/media_player.py", line 848, in async_browse_media
    response = await build_item_response(self._kodi, payload)
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/kodi/browse_media.py", line 151, in build_item_response
    children=[item_payload(item, media_library) for item in media],

## Additional information

Strangely I added this Integration the first time and i Could browse  my TV series but not my Movie files.
Thanks @cgtobi to have maybe a look 👍
comments: All right I guess it has been merged in latest 0.115.0b1 because the version before seemed working at least for TV Shows.

review_comments: What does this library contain? Is it other types than music? We have defined `MEDIA_CLASS_DIRECTORY` as an item with children where we can't define the media type. If we can define it as music, we should not use `MEDIA_CLASS_DIRECTORY`.
